children: Enbridge announced a definitive agreement to acquire Tallgrass Energy’s crude transportation, gathering, storage and terminaling assets for US$2.55 billion.
Acquisition includes 75% of Pony Express (≈460 kbpd), 51% of Powder River Gateway (~240 kbpd) and ~8.4M bbl storage.
Purchase price of US$2.55B (subject to closing adjustments), ~10–11x forward EV/EBITDA multiple.
Includes PXP2 expansion (~US$0.3B) to raise Pony Express to ~515 kbpd, underpinned by take-or-pay contracts, in service late 2027.
Deal expected to close later in 2026 pending regulatory approvals, including FTC Hart-Scott-Rodino clearance.
Transaction expected to be accretive to distributable cash flow per share in first full year; equity offering to partially fund acquisition.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Enbridge to buy Tallgrass crude assets for $2.55B, adds Pony Express and 8.4M bbl storage
